sourceEvidence.authority: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1, §20.1 Common non-entity object format
sourceEvidence.finding: The object common header, pre-R2010 data-end-bit field, R2004+ extension-dictionary flag, R2007+ string stream, and object handle stream vary by revision. The prior test helper emitted only its AC1027-style encoding and could not produce valid AC1015/AC1018/AC1021 controls.

implementation.change: The from-scratch raw custom-object helper now emits the explicit object-data end bit for AC1015 through AC1021, the versioned XDictionary and DataStorage flags, and the bounded R2007+ empty string stream. The CLI disposition selector now exercises six supported writer revisions.

observations.projection: Every generated case reports the exact skipped custom-class and unsupported-object counts; the distinct-class profile reports three source names.
observations.frameDisposition: All cases report complete source-frame disposition with no parse failures.
observations.strictOutput: Every conversion is refused before output publication; the pre-existing destination sentinel and source bytes remain unchanged.

manualEarlierRevisionChecks.AC1015: one source frame published as skipped custom/unsupported object, zero parse failures, complete coverage; strict output refused
manualEarlierRevisionChecks.AC1018: one source frame published as skipped custom/unsupported object, zero parse failures, complete coverage; strict output refused
manualEarlierRevisionChecks.AC1021: one source frame published as skipped custom/unsupported object, zero parse failures, complete coverage; strict output refused

focusedTest.coverage: Six source revisions by three locally generated skipped-custom-class profiles, with exact count projection, complete frame accounting, strict refusal, destination sentinel preservation, and unchanged source bytes.

limits: Generated custom-class/object profiles qualify disposition accounting only, not semantic support or successful output for these skipped objects.
Other malformed, partial, recovery, and raw-only CLI disposition profiles remain open under P6-F.
All generated files are temporary; no DWG/DXF fixtures were added.
